title: Installation of 7.5kVA DG Set at Androth (East) Lighthouse
summary: E-tender for installation of a 7.5 kVA diesel generator set at Androth (East) Lighthouse, Lakshadweep, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR from any nationalised/RBI approved bank in favour of The Director, Directorate of Lighthouses & Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; original due 30.08.2023 15:00. Small Scale Industries with valid NSIC/MSME certificate exempted from EMD.

eligibility: Reputed OEM or their authorised suppliers, licensed electrical contractors, parties or Government undertakings
notes: Two-page short Section 1 NIT; no BOQ, completion period or bid validity printed. Bid download 17.08.2023 09:00 and submission 17.08.2023 10:00, both to 31.08.2023 15:00; technical bids opened 01.09.2023 16:00.
